svg.title: September 22 — upper casing split into removable halves
svg.text: September 22 — upper casing split into removable halves
One longitudinal casing half remains vertical beside the shaft.
The detached matching half lies to the right, ready for handling.
Large excavators work around the newly exposed shaft heads.
Angular rock-rich material covers the active excavation zone.
Observed features are numbered; the photograph does not establish the specific fuel gas.
